source_family: Byte-for-byte preservation of official General Court online source responses
observed_result: The acquisition environment could inspect parsed official government page content, but the raw-file download channel did not return the original response body. No page was represented as a raw archival copy.
next_action: Retry raw HTML/PDF acquisition in a network environment that can preserve the original response body, response headers, final URL, retrieval timestamp, size, and SHA-256. Keep normalized capsules explicitly non-verbatim until then.
